paragraphs: In [Shabbat 66b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.66b.7): Adda Mari speaks in the name of Rav Nachman bar Baruch, who cites Rav Ashi bar Avin in the name of Rav Yehudah.
[Moed Katan 16](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.16a.11) gives a different chain in Hyman’s account, with Rabbi Nechemyah bar Baruch.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Shabbat chain concerns the knots worn by children and names Nachman and Ashi.

The linked Moed Katan is a different discussion. In it, Adda Mari cites Nechemyah bar Baruch, with no title, who cites Rav Chiyya bar Avin in the name of Rav Yehudah. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2688&lang=en) juxtaposes the two chains and judges one erroneous.
